proposal.summary: An authorization/sensitive information disclosure vulnerability was identified in GitHub Enterprise Server that allowed a fork to retain read access to an upstream repository after its visibility was changed to private.
proposal.affected_product: GitHub Enterprise Server versions prior to 3.10.0
proposal.cwe_quote: The vulnerability allowed a fork to retain read access to an upstream repository after its visibility was changed to private.

AV.quote: The vulnerability allowed a fork to retain read access to an upstream repository.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Review and apply the latest patches for GitHub Enterprise Server.

evidence_quotes.claim: The vulnerability allowed a fork to retain read access to an upstream repository after its visibility was changed to private.
evidence_quotes.quote: An authorization/sensitive information disclosure vulnerability was identified in GitHub Enterprise Server that allowed a fork to retain read access to an upstream repository after its visibility was changed to private.

evidence_quotes.claim: This vulnerability affected all versions of GitHub Enterprise Server prior to 3.10.0.
evidence_quotes.quote: This vulnerability affected all versions of GitHub Enterprise Server prior to 3.10.0 and was fixed in versions 3.9.4, 3.8.9, 3.7.16 and 3.6.18.
